newsitem.title: UK: UK grain futures down after EU export news.
newsitem.headline: UK grain futures down after EU export news.

text.p: LIFFE wheat futures ended lower after news the EU may be looking at an early end to its export campaign.
"Futures have run out of steam. They already looked softish on Friday," one trader said.
But much of Monday's fall followed directly from the EU news, he said.
May, which dominated volume, came down by 1.15 stg, to 98.50 stg. May volume was 309 of a total 418 lots.

The European Union may wrap up soft wheat exports for the 1996/97 campaign before the traditional end-April deadline, having already exported substantial volumes, an EU Commission official said on Monday.
"We are not very far from the end of the campaign. It may be over before end-April," the official told Reuters.
